title: Redbyte
description: Adds robots that can be programmed in-game using a custom simple language.
body:
Redbyte

**Programmable robots inside Minecraft** Redbyte introduces robots, a programmable robotic entity that can be controlled using a simple custom language. Design automation and create your own robotic helpers directly inside your world. This mod is still in its very beginning phase. [Go to CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/redbyte)
[Go to Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/redbyte)
[Go to Discord](https://discord.gg/Qszbf3bAg7)
[Go to GitHub](https://github.com/Stonygeist123/Redbyte) **✨ Features** **🤖 Robo – a robot that can interact with the world** **🧠 Simple Programming Language – control Robo with custom behavior scripts** _(documentations will be added soon)_ **🧪 Designed for experimentation, automation, and creative problem solving** **🎮 Gameplay Focus** Redbyte aims to become a tech progression & utility mod centered around robotics. You can: 1. Prototype automation ideas 2. Create utility robots for tasks and world interaction 3. Build programmable systems instead of static machines **🔥 Unique Concept** Unlike traditional tech mods, Redbyte focuses on: * Programmable behavior * Player-driven logic instead of predefined automation * Expandable tech ecosystem planned for future versions **⚙️ Requirements** Minecraft: 1.21.1 Loader: Forge Multiplayer: Expected to work (report issues if found) **🐛 Feedback & Issues** Redbyte is actively evolving. Report bugs, ideas, and suggestions to help shape future robotics features. **❤️ Support Development** If you enjoy experimenting with Redbyte, consider following the project for updates and join the Discord server.
